calls.reason: The evidence is mixed. Anthropic's disclosure says the showcased bugs were patched and access was restricted, but also reports sandbox escapes and non-experts getting working exploits. The media portrayal Marcus describes could not be verified.

Point Estimate puts Mythos only a month or two ahead on general benchmarks, but flags its own post as out of date. Epoch puts the April release about 7 months ahead on cyber. That leaves the broad claim unsettled.

In AISLE's isolated-code tests, all eight models (several open-weight) caught the FreeBSD bug, and small open models recovered the core OpenBSD chain. That is a fair amount in a simplified setup, though they missed Mythos's delivery trick and had false positives.
